## Task 1

Download the Sentinel 2 Image from [moodle](https://moodle.zhaw.ch/) (*CW40 - Image Classification of Remote Sensing Data*). Alternatively, download the data from the [Copernicus browser](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/).

Import the bands R, B, G and NIR as a raster image in R (see [Spectral Bands (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sentinel-2#Spectral_bands)). Make sure to convert the digital numbers to surface reflectance values.

```{r}
library(terra)
library(stringr)

s2_files <- list.files("data/Sentinel2_Data", full.names = TRUE)

names(s2_files) <- str_match(s2_files, "B.{2}")[,1]

s2_select <- s2_files[names(s2_files) %in% c("B02", "B03","B04","B08")]

s2 <- rast(s2_select)

names(s2) <- names(s2_select)

s2 <- (s2 - 1000) / 10000
```
